LanguageData.SSC_Pna_InvalidTarget: This pawn cannot currently receive a PNA test dose.
LanguageData.SSC_Pna_Rooted: Debug: chained activation load {0}%. No ordinary addiction is created.
LanguageData.SSC_Pna_DebugResult: Debug: current load {0}%. Full load can create addiction in an ordinary body; debug inputs do not strengthen existing addiction.
LanguageData.SSC_Pna_NewDependence: {0} can no longer do without aphrodisiac nanofluid.
LanguageData.SSC_Pna_InfoLoadPerDoseDesc: Base PNA load provided by one dose, as a percentage of full load. Applicable body and tolerance modifiers are applied on ingestion. Masters are immune to drug effects; pawns with an effective Chain receive activation.
LanguageData.SSC_Pna_InfoAddictionThresholdDesc: An ordinary body develops addiction when a real input brings its load to full. If the recipient is already addicted and the load after input is at least {0}, addiction severity increases by an additional {1} on top of the base increase. Masters and pawns with an effective Chain do not develop ordinary addiction.
